mechanics.claim: Gwen dashes to the target location and then gains the empowered attack buff.
mechanics.quote: '''Gwen''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location, then empowers her {{tip|basic attacks}}

mechanics.claim: The first basic attack during the buff refunds a percentage of Skip 'n Slash's cooldown.
mechanics.quote: '''Gwen's''' first basic attack within the duration refunds a percentage of ''Skip 'n Slash's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: Skip 'n Slash resets Gwen's basic attack timer and can be cast during any of her other abilities, and vice versa.
mechanics.quote: ''Skip 'n Slash {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Gwen's''' basic attack timer, and can be cast during any of her abilities, and vice versa.''

mechanics.claim: There is no cast time; the queue time is 0.5 seconds.
